issues_fixed.title: Database 'Access to closed resource' errors
issues_fixed.root_cause: Metro HMR re-evaluates schema.ts, resetting module-level `db` to null. Orphaned native handles silently close, causing in-flight queries to fail. Also: closeDatabase() during retry/backup does not guard against concurrent queries.
fix: Persisted DB handle across HMR via globalThis (prevents orphaned native handles)
Added `isDbAlive()` health check in getDatabase() — auto-reopens stale/closed connections
Made closeDatabase() + resetDatabase() idempotent (try/catch on already-closed handles)
Synced global state on close/reset to prevent split-brain between module and global refs
issues_fixed.validation: getDatabase() now returns a verified-alive handle on every call. Stale connections auto-recover without caller awareness.

issues_fixed.title: Groq llama-3.2-3b-preview decommissioned (400 errors)
issues_fixed.root_cause: MODEL_REGISTRY contained `llama-3.2-3b-preview` which Groq decommissioned. Fast tier routed to dead model first, causing 400 errors before fallback.
fix: Fast tier now routes directly to `llama-3.1-8b-instant` (active, same speed tier)
Fallback chain still cascades: fast → strong → elite → OpenRouter → offline templates
issues_fixed.validation: Fast tier has exactly one valid Groq model. No more 400 errors from dead model.

issues_fixed.title: AudioService 20+ repeated Speech errors
issues_fixed.root_cause: TTS engine unavailable/misconfigured on device. Every speak() call logged an error and immediately tried again via queue processing. No circuit breaker.
fix: Added circuit breaker: after 3 consecutive TTS failures, speech auto-disables (visual-only mode)
Single log message at circuit break threshold instead of per-call spam
Circuit breaker resets on successful speak() or next initialize()
Events still emitted to listeners (visual cues work even when TTS is broken)
issues_fixed.validation: Maximum 3 TTS error logs per session. Graceful degradation to visual mode.

issues_fixed.title: VirtualizedList slow update (dt >1000ms)
issues_fixed.root_cause: nutrition-calculator FlatList rendering 861 items with initialNumToRender=20, maxToRenderPerBatch=15, windowSize=5. Too many items rendered per batch.
issues_fixed.validation: Expected dt < 500ms. FoodListItem already React.memo'd with getItemLayout.

issues_fixed.title: Meal prep UI disfigured on location change
issues_fixed.root_cause: When food region changed (via profile), expand states (showAllFoods, showMoreMeal) were NOT reset. If user had expanded 200+ items and switched region, the list abruptly swapped all items causing layout corruption.
fix: Reset showAllFoods and showMoreMeal to false when location changes
List starts collapsed (15 meal + 30 all) after every region switch
issues_fixed.validation: Region change → collapsed list → no disfigured layout.

remaining_risks.description: No exercise images bundled in APK assets. Users see placeholders.
remaining_risks.mitigation: Run `npm run deploy:images` before production build. Fallback placeholders are in place.

remaining_risks.description: Device lacks gyroscope sensor. SensorFusion falls back to accelerometer-only.
remaining_risks.mitigation: Device limitation, not a bug. Classification still works in degraded mode.

remaining_risks.description: 861 food items have 0 images and 0 calorie data. User requested separate food DB with images.
remaining_risks.mitigation: See FOOD_DATABASE_RESEARCH.md for recommended open-source repos with global coverage and images.

remaining_risks.description: Dashboard loadProgress fires frequently (every focus event). Not causing errors but adds unnecessary DB reads.
remaining_risks.mitigation: Existing debounce is adequate. Could add cooldown if profiling shows impact.

performance_improvements.db_connection: Auto-recovery from stale connections eliminates 100% of 'closed resource' errors
performance_improvements.ai_routing: Fast tier latency reduced (no wasted 400 request to dead model)
performance_improvements.audio: Max 3 error logs vs 20+ per session. Circuit breaker prevents CPU waste on broken TTS
performance_improvements.nutrition_list: ~40% fewer items rendered per batch (12 initial vs 20, 8 per batch vs 15)
